title: NFL slams NBC's Mike Florio, Chris Simms for 'offensive' Mike Vrabel joke

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL slams NBC's Mike Florio, Chris Simms for 'offensive' Mike Vrabel joke
sources.description: Mike Florio and Chris Simms made a joke at the expense of Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel that included a thinly veiled reference to Adolf Hitler.
